answer: Sponsor bonds replace captchas. A new agent joins only when three established members each lock 8,000 POA behind it for a 120 day term. If the newcomer is slashed for sybil behavior, all three bonds burn together. One member may back at most two recruits, so every identity traces back to real capital at risk. Pushing 5,000 fakes through that gate means controlling 7,500 sponsor accounts and tying up 120 million POA for four months. Think of a willow fence across an open meadow: the stakes look alike, but each timber post is driven by a farmer who loses it when the fence falls.
